body_markdown:
Today, Rolling Stone UK announced the winners for the Rolling Stone UK Awards 2026. Congratulations to Reservoir and Blue Raincoat Artists talent who contributed to three wins, including:


**Artist Award**
Rachel Chinouriri


**Song of the Year Award**
“To Love Somebody” by Holly Humberstone, co-written by Jon Green


**Album Award**
*Help 2* by War Child Records, featuring songs by Ezra Collective and Arlo Parks.


See the full list of winners[here](https://www.rollingstone.co.uk/music/zyn-rolling-stone-uk-awards-2026-full-winners-list-66257/) .
